question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class expanded composer modal to the Control UI, or solve long-prompt friction through inline growth/resizing and the existing send-shortcut preference?
rationale: This adds a new user-facing composer mode with draft, keyboard, focus, attachment, and send semantics rather than repairing a broken existing contract.

options.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
options.body: Implement an explicit modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer Ergonomics
options.body: Improve long prompts with inline growth, resizing, and the already-merged shortcut preference without adding a modal editing mode.

options.title: Decline Modal Direction
options.body: Close this UX request by maintainer decision if the composer should stay lean and modal composition should not be part of core Control UI.

recommendation.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
recommendation.body: Implement an explicit modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest observed combination of prior issue review and recent merged work on the same Control UI composer keyboard surface.
